result.title: 비빔국수 (Spicy Mixed Noodles)

ingredients.rawText: 고추장 1스푼 (1 spoon of red pepper paste)

evidences.text: 볼에 고추장 1스푼 / 1 spoon of red pepper paste
진간장(금F3) 2스푼 / 2 spoons of soy sauce
Red pepper powder is seen added in the bowl before vinegar
식초 2스푼 / 2 spoons of vinegar
설탕 2스푼 / 2 spoons of sugar
참기름 1스푼 / 1 spoon of sesame oil
통깨 챱챱 / Sesame
Sesame seeds shaken into sauce and later sprinkled on top of the noodles
Chopped kimchi is visible mixed in the sauce bowl
끓는 물에 국수 1인분 / 1 serving of noodles in boiling water
삶은 계란 / boiled egg
Half of a hard-boiled egg placed on top of noodles

ingredients.rawText: 김가루 조금 (A little bit of seaweed flakes)

evidences.text: 김가루 조금 / A little bit of seaweed flakes

steps.text: In a bowl, combine 1 spoon of red pepper paste, 2 spoons of soy sauce, red pepper powder, 2 spoons of vinegar, 2 spoons of sugar, 1 spoon of sesame oil, and sesame seeds, then mix thoroughly to make the sauce.

evidences.text: 볼에 고추장 1스푼 / 1 spoon of red pepper paste
진간장(금F3) 2스푼 / 2 spoons of soy sauce
식초 2스푼 / 2 spoons of vinegar
설탕 2스푼 / 2 spoons of sugar
참기름 1스푼 / 1 spoon of sesame oil
통깨 챱챱 / Sesame
섞어주면 양념장 끝 / If you mix it, it's over

steps.text: Add 1 serving of noodles to boiling water and cook for 5 minutes.

evidences.text: 끓는 물에 국수 1인분 / 1 serving of noodles in boiling water
5분 끓여주고 / Boil for 5 minutes

steps.text: Rinse the cooked noodles in cold water and drain well.

evidences.text: 찬물 샤워 / Rinse it in cold water
물기 뺀 국수 넣고 / drained noodles

steps.text: Add the drained noodles to the bowl with the sauce (which contains chopped kimchi) and mix thoroughly by hand.

evidences.text: 물기 뺀 국수 넣고 / drained noodles
무챠무챠 / Mix it

steps.text: Transfer the mixed noodles to a serving bowl and garnish with boiled egg, seaweed flakes, and sesame seeds.

evidences.text: 삶은 계란 / boiled egg
김가루 조금 / A little bit of seaweed flakes
Sesame seeds sprinkled over the egg and noodles
